testSuite: Phase 15.3 Height-40,000 Transition Boundary Adversarial Suite

boundaryPropertiesTested.name: Height 39,999 Historical Validator Behavior
boundaryPropertiesTested.expected: Genesis validator quorum accepted; rotated validators rejected

boundaryPropertiesTested.name: Height 40,000 Exact Transition Activation
boundaryPropertiesTested.expected: Rotated validator quorum accepted; genesis validators rejected

boundaryPropertiesTested.name: Height 40,001 Forward Quorum Authorization
boundaryPropertiesTested.expected: Only rotated validator set authorized to sign

boundaryPropertiesTested.name: Old Validator Individual Signatures Rejected
boundaryPropertiesTested.expected: ErrRevokedValidator returned for any vote signed by genesis keys

boundaryPropertiesTested.name: Old Validator Full Certificates Rejected
boundaryPropertiesTested.expected: Full commit certificate forged by old keys strictly rejected

boundaryPropertiesTested.name: Invalid or Unauthorized Transition Rejected
boundaryPropertiesTested.expected: Height <= 0, empty sets, or missing auth rejected with explicit error

boundaryPropertiesTested.name: Conflicting Transition Proposals Rejected
boundaryPropertiesTested.expected: ErrConflictingTransition returned when duplicate height proposed

boundaryPropertiesTested.name: Replay of Old Transition Rejected
boundaryPropertiesTested.expected: ErrReplayedTransition returned when height <= latest transition

boundaryPropertiesTested.name: Restart Before and After Transition
boundaryPropertiesTested.expected: Restarts at H=39,998 restore genesis; restarts at H=40,005 restore rotated

boundaryPropertiesTested.name: Network Partition Across Transition Boundary
boundaryPropertiesTested.expected: Partition catch-up applies blocks sequentially and validates against schedule

boundaryPropertiesTested.name: Recovery from Partition Without Rollback
boundaryPropertiesTested.expected: Malicious block rollback attempts to old validator set rejected

boundaryPropertiesTested.name: Historical Block and Certificate Verification
boundaryPropertiesTested.expected: All blocks H < 40,000 remain verifiable against historical genesis keys

boundaryPropertiesTested.name: Financial State and AppHash Invariance
boundaryPropertiesTested.expected: Total supply (30T uSOV), balances, and AppHash unaffected by rotation
